title: Walking Aids
description: Walking sticks, quad canes, walkers, and folding walkers to support safe mobility and independence during rehabilitation.

products.name: Walking Stick Single Leg
features: Lightweight aluminium shaft with push-button height adjustment
Ergonomic contoured handle reduces hand and wrist fatigue
Rubber ferrule tip provides grip on a variety of floor surfaces
Folds or collapses for convenient storage and transport
benefits: Provides a stable third point of contact for patients with mild balance impairment
Reduces load on the affected lower limb during post-injury or post-surgical walking
Promotes safe ambulation in elderly patients at risk of falls
Lightweight aluminium design minimises upper limb effort during use

products.name: Walking Stick Four Leg
features: Quad-base with four rubber-tipped contact points for a wide, stable footprint
Adjustable shaft height to suit patients of varying stature
Offset handle positions the user's weight optimally over the base
Robust aluminium construction withstands daily clinical and home use
benefits: Offers significantly greater lateral stability than a single-tip cane
Reduces fall risk for patients with hemiplegia, significant weakness, or severe balance deficits
Supports weight-bearing patients who need more than a standard stick can provide
Can stand unsupported, keeping it within reach without bending to pick it up

products.name: Walker
features: Lightweight aluminium frame with four rubber-tipped legs
Width and height adjustable to accommodate different body dimensions
Open front design facilitates a natural step-through gait pattern
No wheels — pick-up-and-place use for maximum stability
benefits: Provides comprehensive upper body support for patients with significant lower limb weakness
Reduces fall risk during early post-operative ambulation after hip and knee replacement
Distributes weight through the arms to offload painful or healing lower limbs
Simple pick-up design gives patients confidence on uneven indoor surfaces

products.name: Walker Folding
features: Folds flat with a single-action folding mechanism for compact storage
Same robust aluminium frame and adjustable height as the standard walker
Rubber-tipped legs maintain grip and floor protection
Carrying strap or bag attachments available for transport convenience
benefits: All the stability benefits of a standard walker with the added convenience of folding flat
Ideal for patients who travel, use public transport, or have limited storage space
Easy to take in a car boot, store in a cupboard, or carry between rooms
Encourages patient compliance with prescribed walking aid use by removing storage barriers
